plan.notes: Source: official North Arkansas College 2025-2026 Academic Catalog, Certificate of Proficiency in Pre-Allied Health degree plan (poid 2057). Catalog prints term total 16-21 and Grand Total 16-21 credits. Seeded with lower bounds (term sum 16); sequenced lower-bound sum is 16, documented as printed.

courses.choice_note: MAT 1013 Careers Math or higher. Catalog note: even if students place into a higher-level Math course, MAT 1013 is preferred to assure that medication calculation is completed in MAT 1013 prior to PN or Paramedic program entry. Lower bound 3 seeded.
courses.title: Careers Math

courses.choice_note: Choice: BIOL 1434 Fundamentals of Anatomy and Physiology (4 cr) or BIOL 2214 Anatomy and Physiology I and BIOL 2224 Anatomy and Physiology II (4 cr each). Lower bound 4 seeded.
courses.title: Fundamentals of Anatomy and Physiology

courses.choice_note: Choice: NA 1006 Community Nursing Assistant (6 cr); NA 1003 Community Nursing Assistant I (3 cr) and NA 1013 Community Nursing Assistant II (3 cr); or EMS 1102 Emergency Medical Technology Practicum (2 cr) and EMS 1105 Emergency Medical Technology (5 cr). Lower bound 6 seeded.
courses.title: Community Nursing Assistant
